newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-IVERSEN TRANSFER TO TOTTENHAM CONFIRMED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVERSEN TRANSFER TO TOTTENHAM CONFIRMED.

text.p: Tottenham signed Norwegian forward Steffen Iversen on Friday under an agreement reached with his club Rosenborg, the Norwegian news agency NTB said.
Rosenborg manager Rune Bratseth said the negotiations in a hotel in Trondheim had been completed but he refused to reveal the transfer sum.

NTB said the price tag was probably somewhere between 2.5 million and 3.0 million pounds ($4.2 and 5 million), making Iversen Norway's most expensive player. Tottenham had reportedly offered 2.3 million pounds ($1.8 million) but Rosenborg asked for more, NTB said.
Ole Gunnar Solskjaer held the old record. Manchester United paid 1.5 million pounds ($2.5 million) for him when he left Molde in the close season.

Iversen, generally regarded as one of the brightest young strikers in Europe, will not join Tottenham until Rosenborg are eliminated from the European Cup which could well be on December 4 when they face Milan in the last round of Champions' League matches.

Their 1-0 win over Sweden's IFK Gothenburg on Wednesday kept their European Cup hopes alive for the time being but they would have to win in Milan to overtake the Italians in Group D to finish second in the group and qualify for the quarter-finals next March.
